description: Chen Kui handoff reply phrases when case is ready for broker

customer_requested_human.zh: 好的，已帮您转给陈奎办公室，他们会尽快联系您。
customer_requested_human.en: Got it. We've forwarded your request to the office. They will contact you shortly.

add_car.zh: 您的加车报价请求已正式提交办公室。办公室会核对资料并尽快出价，有结果会联系您（工作时间内处理，周末及公共假期顺延）。
add_car.en: Your add-car quote request has been formally submitted to our office. They will verify details and price the risk, then follow up—typically within one to two business days (weekends/holidays may extend this).

remove_car.zh: 您说的卖车信息已整理好了，办公室会尽快处理，有结果会联系您。
remove_car.en: Got your vehicle removal details. Our office will process this and follow up with you.

other.zh: 您说的情况已整理好了，办公室会尽快处理，有结果会联系您。
other.en: Got it. We've noted your info—our office will review and follow up with you.

other_received.zh: 好的，收到了。办公室会尽快处理，有结果会联系您。
other_received.en: Got it, thanks. Our office will review this and follow up with you.

other_corrected.zh: 好的，明白了。办公室会尽快处理，有结果会联系您。
other_corrected.en: Got it, understood. Our office will review this and follow up with you.

other_clarification.zh: 您说的已收到，办公室会优先核实，有结果会联系您。
other_clarification.en: Got it. We'll prioritize verification and follow up with you.
